# Eval Formula Node

![Eval Formula Node function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/formula-evaluation/07_Eval%20Formula%20Node%20VI.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Evaluates ordered mathematical assignments separated by semicolons. Output order follows Variables Output. y=2*x+z;p=q^2; with inputs [x,z,q]=[3,4,5],outputs [p,y] gives[25,10]. Loops, memory and system scripts are unavailable. Fixed exact f64/Array signatures, without scalar lifting, broadcasting or implicit numeric conversion. Explicit FROG profile frog.studio.formula.evaluation@1 is distinct from the historical ODE dialect. Prepared payloads are validated versioned AST, never source to re-parse at evaluation or native pointers. NI connector documentation does not establish prepared binary compatibility or measured algorithm parity. Error in/out use the standard Error Cluster; incoming active errors are preserved.
